skills.title: Grenade
skills.description: Damage to armored units +50%

skills.title: Samurai
skills.description: Possess the warrior's will; the combat effectiveness will not go down when HP is reduced

skills.title: Camouflage Cover
skills.description: Cannot be chosen as the target of direct damage active skills. Immune to all debuffs. Damage received is reduced by 30% when attacked from 1 tile away and by 15% when attacked from 2–3 tiles away.

skills.title: Decapitation Strike
skills.description: Mark 1 targets within a 2-tile range and ignore their dodge, smoke bomb, or stealth effects. Damage dealt to each marked target is increased by 60% for one turn, with a cooldown of two turns. If a marked target is killed by Delta Force, an additional attack can be made, and damage for that attack is increased by an extra 20%

levels.note:
Unlock Grenade
Unlock Samurai
Unlock Camouflage Cover
Unlock Decapitation Strike
